authorization: Mingli requested the explore/open/universe finite calibration on 2026-09-06
question: For the same finite open equation, which evidence permits existence, complete enumeration or uniqueness to be decided before the declared universe is exhausted?
level: external finite arithmetic and proposed vocabulary; no native semantics or open-world completeness
grammar: Horner quadratic (a*x+b)*x+c over F7; x is a typed open position; a,b,c,rhs are canonical F7 elements

goals.all: return precisely every satisfying x in U
goals.unique: there exists exactly one satisfying x in U

policies: goal_aware: stop at first witness for exists or second distinct witness for unique
exhaustive: visit the whole declared U unless fuel is exhausted
